meal.title: Read the player's choice
meal.objective: You can ask the player for input and store it as a string

voice.script: What text does the computer need to know your move? How do we capture the player's choice? The input function displays a prompt and waits for the player to type something, then returns that text as a string. We also call lower to turn any capital letters into lowercase so comparisons are simple. On the screen you can picture an input_output diagram showing the prompt and the entered text. ').lower() After this line runs, the variable user_choice holds whatever the player typed, all in lowercase. Store the player's move as a lowercase string for easy comparison. Try changing the prompt to ask for a secret word.
